title: you've got the time
style: pink panther creaping, investigation, suspense, detective.
lyrics:
you've got the time

 know what to do
follow through!

middle of the court
keep your back swing short

'n' the service line
requires none, 
zero, zero or 
zero... one

you've got the time

they poke it
you stoke it 

they roll it 
you catch it

maximum ball time on the paddle
caress and straddle

you've got the time

"A 10th of a second more paddle time
 can, be, the difference, in the game.
The difference between an out, or, an in ball."

your body moves
behind the ball
following
your paddle direction and line
youll get it everytime!

now you have arrived
its time to slow down time.

you've got the time

the ball floats, like a butterfly.
 a fluffy cloud meeandering in the sky

tiny steps, breath and set
blocking fine, if zero time

you've got the time, you've got the time
Once it sticks, you'll be fine.
